Name: Kiwi's Custom Pet Sprite (Adopt 'N Skin)
Author: ThinkingKiwi
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Kiwi's Custom Sprite :: Dog Edition[/size][/b][/center]
[quote]EDIT: Hey everyone! This is a mod i've created in 2020 but forgot to officially 'publish' it to nexus! I haven't really played stardew in years, but I still wanted to share it and so I did, even though it's basically orphaned at this point haha.
Some members have brought to my attention that adopt 'n skin isn't really working anymore and ENGloomy was kind enough to make a CP version of it! I've stickied their post in the comment section!!
I'm just gonna say that if anyone ever wants to use/edit this sprite/add it to their own mod, you have my permission!! (just mention my name as the og creator of the sprite, pls :3)
Thank you all so much! ♥[/quote]

[center][size=5][b]Original Description[/b][/size]

Hello!~ I have always wanted to give a try and make my own animal skins to use with Adopt 'n' Skin, and since I have quite a bit of free time right now, I decided to start! Currently, there's only one but I plan on adding more as I complete and test them! :3
Keep in mind, these are *just* png files and will not work by itself, you [b]NEED[/b] Adopt 'n' skin! (It may also work with any other skin mod that uses png files to pull skins into the game)

[b][size=4]The Sprite:[/size][/b]
[size=3]Angel
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6914/6914-1600901390-472470845.png[/img]﻿[/size]
Based on my real-life Poodle - Skin ID: 70
(I used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5727458]haleatsburrito[/url]'s Small doges from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1853]yet another dog mod[/url]﻿ as a reference, so if you like this, consider also downloading their mod!) [/center]

[left][b][size=4]Installation [/size]{Adopt 'n Skin ver.}[/b]

[b]1[/b].Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'N' Skin[/url]
[b]2[/b].Download my mod
[b]3[/b].Copy the 'skins' folder into "Mods\AdoptSkin\assets"
[b]4[/b].If prompted to overwrite files, DO [b]NOT[/b] OVERWRITE! choose to rename the files instead. Otherwise, you will lose any pre-downloaded skins you might have.[/left]
